chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Ibn al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) forbade the saddle to be ridden by a female.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet (SAWW) forbid regarding disciplining women with a saddle?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi records the Prophet’s prohibition against placing a saddle directly on a woman’s private part (farj) as a method of discipline, reflecting the Shia emphasis on moderation and avoiding excessive harshness in marital correction. Scholars interpret this as a specific limitation on corporal punishment, ensuring that discipline does not become degrading or cause undue pain to the most sensitive areas of the body.
